summary: Expected buckets can absorb unrelated c26/c27 flips and falsely clear the zero-unexplained kill criterion.
UnicodeDecodeError from malformed mirror sources escapes fail-open handling and can crash verifier import.
The 4.6k-plan sweep truncates output on restart and reports progress only every 250 units.
The report claims zero old-symbol hits although the new corpus script intentionally retains _C27_L4_INTENTS compatibility.
verify_plan.py fail-open guard widened to except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError); new test_c26_mirror_fail_open_undecodable_source pins static fallback + lane_head=runpod.
Sweep classify c26 arm replaced fams_old!=fams_new with a directional predicate replaying the offender rule per mirror; corpus re-swept, unexplained=0 re-verified.
Sweep gained per-unit flush, one stdout line per completed unit, and a 4-key header-regime resume predicate; docstring now matches realized behavior.
Prose-only per reconciler (overruled as a blocker): epm:results v2 records 1 hit at the sweep's getattr compat read, disposed as the documented pre-2514 BEFORE-leg fallback.
The c26 corpus oracle duplicates production c26 over the same mirror and cannot reject a wrong mirror-consistent transition.
